power_gate.name: Statistical Power Gate
power_gate.required: N_fraud >= 86 mature fraud observations for 80% power at delta = +0.015

statistical_gate.name: Statistical Significance Gate
statistical_gate.required: Paired Bootstrap 95% CI strictly excluding zero (p < 0.05)
statistical_gate.observed: Offline Holdout 95% CI = [-0.0287, +0.0765], p = 0.2980 (Inconclusive on N_fraud=52)

economic_gate.name: Economic Gate
economic_gate.required: Defensible net economic loss reduction on live traffic

engineering_gate.name: Engineering & Fail-Open Isolation Gate
engineering_gate.required: 100% fail-open customer isolation; challenger cannot alter routing
engineering_gate.observed: 100% fail-open verified across all failure tests

provenance_gate.name: Provenance & Zero-Contamination Gate
provenance_gate.required: Zero non-live records (replay/staging/synthetic) in promotion stats

security_gate.name: Security & Privacy Gate
security_gate.required: HMAC-SHA256 verification, zero PAN/CVV retention, zero secrets in code
security_gate.observed: Zero PAN/CVV stored, AWS Secrets Manager mapped

governance_gate.name: Governance & Model Invariant Gate
governance_gate.required: Champion checksum immutable, docs/ untouched, reproducible artifacts
